intro: 等效变换的核心只有一句话：**对外等效**——两个单口网络端口上的 u–i 关系完全相同，就可以互相替换，而端口以外的电压、电流都不变。被替换掉的那部分内部的电流、功率**不**等效，要求它们必须回到原电路。

en.intro: Everything in this chapter rests on one sentence: **equivalent to the outside** — two one-ports with exactly the same u–i relation at their terminals can replace each other, and every voltage and current outside them stays the same. Currents and powers *inside* the replaced part are **not** preserved; to find them, go back to the original circuit.

ideas.title: 等效的含义：对外等效，对内不等效
text: 两个单口网络（二端网络）如果端口电压、电流的关系（VCR）完全相同，就称它们**等效**。用一个简单的等效网络代替复杂的部分，外电路的所有电压、电流都不变。
等效只对**外电路**成立：被替换部分内部的电流、电压和功率一般都变了。所以常见的步骤是“化简 → 求出端口电压或电流 → 回到原电路求内部的量”。

en.title: What “equivalent” means: same at the terminals, not inside
text: Two one-ports (two-terminal networks) are **equivalent** if their terminal voltage–current relations (VCR) are identical. Replacing a complicated part by a simple equivalent leaves every voltage and current of the external circuit unchanged.

The equivalence holds only for the **external circuit**: currents, voltages and powers inside the replaced part generally change. Hence the usual route: simplify → find the terminal voltage or current → go back to the original circuit for the internal quantities.

ideas.title: 串联与并联：分压与分流
text: **串联**：各元件流过同一个电流，R = R_1 + R_2 + …；电压按电阻**成正比**分配（分压公式）。
**并联**：各元件两端是同一个电压，电导相加 G = G_1 + G_2 + …；电流按电导成正比、即按电阻**成反比**分配（分流公式）。两个电阻并联时，分流公式的分子是**另一个**电阻。
判断串并联只看结点：两个元件之间没有别的支路分出去才是串联；两端分别接在同一对结点上才是并联。

en.title: Series and parallel: voltage and current dividers
text: **Series**: the elements carry the same current, R = R_1 + R_2 + …; the voltage divides **in proportion to** resistance (voltage divider).

**Parallel**: the elements share the same voltage, conductances add, G = G_1 + G_2 + …; the current divides in proportion to conductance, i.e. **inversely** to resistance (current divider). For two resistors the numerator of the current divider is the **other** resistor.
Decide by the nodes: two elements are in series only if no other branch leaves the node between them; they are in parallel if both ends sit on the same pair of nodes.

ideas.title: 混联电路与“重画”
text: 混联电路从**离端口最远**的地方开始，一步步向端口合并串联、并联。等效电阻与“从哪两个端子看进去”有关：换一对端子，结果就不同；一端悬空的电阻没有电流，不计入。
电路画得乱时先**标结点**：用导线直接相连的点是同一个结点，给每个结点起个名字，写到每个电阻的两端，再按结点重画。两端是同一对结点的电阻就是并联；被导线短接（两端是同一结点）的电阻可以去掉。

en.title: Series–parallel networks and redrawing
text: Start **farthest from the port** and merge series and parallel groups step by step towards it. The equivalent resistance depends on which two terminals you look into: another pair gives another result, and a resistor with one end floating carries no current and drops out.

If the drawing is confusing, **label the nodes** first: points joined by wire are one node; name each node, write the names at both ends of every resistor, and redraw by nodes. Resistors between the same pair of nodes are in parallel; a resistor shorted by a wire (both ends on one node) can be removed.

ideas.title: 平衡电桥
text: 四个桥臂 R_1、R_2、R_3、R_4 加一条桥支路 R_5。当**对臂电阻乘积相等**（R_1·R_4 = R_2·R_3，按图中对臂配对）时，电桥平衡：桥支路两端等电位，其中电流为零。
平衡时桥支路既可以看成**开路**，也可以看成**短路**——选让串并联最好算的那种。等电位的两点之间接什么（电阻、导线、断开）都不影响其余电路。不平衡时不能这样做，要用 Y–Δ 变换或下一章的方法。

en.title: The balanced bridge
text: Four arms R_1, R_2, R_3, R_4 and a bridge branch R_5. When the **products of opposite arms are equal** (R_1·R_4 = R_2·R_3, pairing opposite arms as drawn) the bridge is balanced: both ends of the bridge branch are at the same potential and it carries no current.

When balanced, the bridge branch can be treated as either an **open** or a **short** circuit — pick whichever makes the series–parallel reduction easier. Whatever sits between two equipotential points (resistor, wire, nothing) does not affect the rest. If the bridge is unbalanced this is not allowed: use a Y–Δ transformation or the methods of the next chapter.

ideas.title: Y–Δ 变换
text: 接在同样三个结点上的 Y 形（星形）和 Δ 形（三角形）连接可以互相等效。**Δ→Y**：某个结点上的 Y 电阻 = 与该结点相连的两个 Δ 电阻之积 / 三个 Δ 电阻之和。**Y→Δ**：某条边上的 Δ 电阻 = Y 电阻两两乘积之和 / 对面那个 Y 电阻。
对称时 R_Δ = 3R_Y。Y 和 Δ 同接在三个结点上时，把一个变成另一种形式，就能逐边并联。
变换只保证三个结点之间的电压不变：在等效电路里求出这三个结点的电压，再回到原电路求被变换掉的电阻中的电流（例如不平衡电桥的桥支路电流）。

en.title: Y–Δ transformation
text: A Y (star) and a Δ (delta) connection on the same three nodes can replace each other. **Δ→Y**: the Y resistor at a node = product of the two Δ resistors touching that node / sum of all three Δ resistors. **Y→Δ**: the Δ resistor on an edge = sum of the pairwise products of the Y resistors / the Y resistor opposite that edge.
In the symmetric case R_Δ = 3R_Y. When a Y and a Δ sit on the same three nodes, convert one into the other's form and combine edge by edge in parallel.

The transformation only preserves the voltages between the three nodes: find them in the equivalent circuit, then return to the original one for the currents in the transformed resistors (e.g. the bridge current of an unbalanced bridge).

ideas.title: 电源的串联、并联与“多余”元件
text: **电压源串联**合并为一个：沿同一方向，极性一致的相加、相反的相减。**电流源并联**合并为一个：方向相同的相加、相反的相减。（不同数值的电压源不能并联，不同数值的电流源不能串联。）
对外电路而言：**与电压源并联**的元件可以去掉（端电压仍是 U_s）；**与电流源串联**的元件可以短接掉（支路电流仍是 I_s）。它们只影响电源自身的电流或电压——求电源的功率、那个元件的电流时要回到原电路。

en.title: Sources in series and parallel; “redundant” elements
text: **Voltage sources in series** combine into one: walking in one direction, add those with the same polarity and subtract the others. **Current sources in parallel** combine likewise: add those pointing the same way, subtract the others. (Unequal voltage sources may not be paralleled, unequal current sources may not be put in series.)

For the external circuit, an element **in parallel with a voltage source** can be removed (the terminal voltage is still U_s), and an element **in series with a current source** can be shorted out (the branch current is still I_s). They only change the source's own current or voltage — for the source's power or that element's current, go back to the original circuit.

ideas.title: 实际电源两种模型的等效变换
text: 电压源 U_s 串联电阻 R ⇔ 电流源 I_s = U_s/R 并联**同一个** R。方向：电流源的箭头指向电压源的“+”端。
用它逐步化简：每次只变换一对“电压源串电阻”或“电流源并电阻”，然后合并串联电压源、并联电流源和串并联电阻；要求的支路保留不动。理想电压源（没有串联电阻）和理想电流源（没有并联电阻）不能互相变换。
**受控源**也可以这样变换（受控电压源串 R ⇔ 受控电流源并 R），但**控制量所在的支路不能被变换掉**，否则控制量就丢了。

en.title: Source transformation between the two models of a practical source
text: A voltage source U_s in series with R ⇔ a current source I_s = U_s/R in parallel with the **same** R. Direction: the current-source arrow points towards the “+” terminal of the voltage source.

Use it step by step: transform one “voltage source + series R” or “current source + parallel R” pair at a time, then merge series voltage sources, parallel current sources and series/parallel resistors; keep the branch you are asked about untouched. An ideal voltage source (no series R) or ideal current source (no parallel R) cannot be transformed.

**Dependent sources** transform the same way (controlled voltage source in series with R ⇔ controlled current source in parallel with R), but **the branch carrying the controlling quantity must not be transformed away**, or the control is lost.

ideas.title: 输入电阻：外加电源法（加压求流）
text: 不含独立源的单口网络，从端口看进去等效为一个电阻：输入电阻 R_in = u/i（u、i 对网络取关联参考方向）。只含电阻时用串并联、Y–Δ 求。
**含受控源**时不能直接串并联，受控源**不能置零**。在端口外加电压 u（或电流 i），把控制量和端口电流都用 u 表示，求 R_in = u/i。
受控源可以使 R_in 为**负**（网络向外发出功率，能量来自受控源），也可以为无穷大。

en.title: Input resistance: the test-source method
text: A one-port with no independent sources is equivalent to a single resistor seen from its port: the input resistance R_in = u/i (u and i associated for the network). With resistors only, use series–parallel and Y–Δ reduction.

**With dependent sources** series–parallel reduction does not work and the dependent source must **not** be set to zero. Apply a test voltage u (or current i) at the port, express the controlling quantity and the port current in terms of u, and take R_in = u/i.
Dependent sources can make R_in **negative** (the network delivers power to the outside, the energy coming from the dependent source) or even infinite.

ideas.title: 无限梯形网络：自相似
text: 向一端无限延伸的梯形网络，去掉前一节后剩下的仍是**同一个**无限网络，所以输入电阻满足一个关于 R_in 自己的方程，例如 R_in = R_1 + R_2 ∥ R_in。解一元二次方程，舍去负根。
求出 R_in 后，每一节的分压比、分流比都相同，电压、电流逐节按同一比例衰减。

en.title: Infinite ladders: self-similarity
text: Removing the first section of an infinite ladder leaves the **same** infinite network, so the input resistance satisfies an equation in itself, e.g. R_in = R_1 + R_2 ∥ R_in. Solve the quadratic and discard the negative root.
With R_in known, every section has the same divider ratio, so voltages and currents shrink by the same factor section after section.

formulas.name: 串联与分压
formulas.when: 各电阻流过同一电流；u 为串联总电压，u_k 与 u 的参考方向一致。

en.name: Series and voltage divider
en.when: Resistors carrying the same current; u is the total series voltage, u_k with the same reference direction as u.

formulas.name: 并联
formulas.when: 各电阻两端是同一对结点（同一电压）。

en.name: Parallel
en.when: Resistors across the same pair of nodes (same voltage).

formulas.name: 分流公式（两个电阻）
formulas.when: R_1、R_2 并联，i 为流入并联组合的总电流，i_1 与 i 同向（都从同一结点流入）。分子是另一个电阻。

en.name: Current divider (two resistors)
en.when: R_1 ∥ R_2, i the total current into the pair, i_1 in the same sense as i (both entering at the same node). The numerator is the other resistor.

formulas.name: 电桥平衡条件
formulas.when: R_1、R_4 为一对对臂，R_2、R_3 为另一对；平衡时桥支路电流为零，可开路或短路处理。

en.name: Bridge balance
en.when: R_1, R_4 one pair of opposite arms, R_2, R_3 the other; when balanced the bridge branch carries no current and may be opened or shorted.

formulas.name: Δ → Y
formulas.when: R_{12} 是接在结点 1、2 之间的 Δ 电阻，R_1 是接在结点 1 上的 Y 电阻；只对三个结点之外等效。

en.name: Δ → Y
en.when: R_{12} is the Δ resistor between nodes 1 and 2, R_1 the Y resistor at node 1; equivalent only as seen from the three nodes.

formulas.name: Y → Δ
formulas.when: 分母是与边 12 相对（不接结点 1、2）的 Y 电阻。

en.name: Y → Δ
en.when: The denominator is the Y resistor opposite edge 12 (not touching nodes 1 and 2).

formulas.name: 对称 Y–Δ
formulas.when: 三个 Y 电阻相等（三个 Δ 电阻相等）。

en.name: Symmetric Y–Δ
en.when: All three Y (and Δ) resistors equal.

formulas.name: 电源合并
formulas.expr: 串联电压源：u_s = Σ ±u_sk；并联电流源：i_s = Σ ±i_sk
formulas.when: 与等效电源方向一致的取 +，相反的取 −。电压源只能与同值电压源并联，电流源只能与同值电流源串联。

en.name: Combining sources
en.expr: series voltage sources: u_s = Σ ±u_sk; parallel current sources: i_s = Σ ±i_sk
en.when: + for sources in the same sense as the equivalent, − otherwise. Voltage sources may be paralleled only if equal, current sources put in series only if equal.

formulas.name: 电源等效变换
formulas.expr: U_s 串 R ⇔ I_s = \frac{U_s}{R} 并 R
formulas.when: 同一个 R；I_s 的箭头指向 U_s 的“+”端；只对外电路等效。受控源同样适用，但控制支路要保留。

en.name: Source transformation
en.expr: U_s in series with R ⇔ I_s = \frac{U_s}{R} in parallel with R
en.when: The same R; the I_s arrow points to the “+” of U_s; equivalent only for the external circuit. Works for dependent sources too, but keep the controlling branch.

formulas.name: 输入电阻
formulas.when: 单口网络内部独立源置零（电压源短路、电流源开路）、受控源保留；端口外加 u（或 i），u、i 对网络为关联参考方向。结果可正、可负。

en.name: Input resistance
en.when: Independent sources inside zeroed (voltage sources shorted, current sources opened), dependent sources kept; apply u (or i) at the port with u, i associated for the network. Can be positive or negative.

formulas.name: 无限梯形网络
formulas.when: 每节为串联 R_1、并联 R_2 的无限梯形网络；取正根。

en.name: Infinite ladder
en.when: Infinite ladder whose sections are a series R_1 and a shunt R_2; take the positive root.

examples.title: 两个实际电源并联供电
examples.statement: 图示电路中 U_s1 = 16 V、R_1 = 4 Ω 和 U_s2 = 4 V、R_2 = 2 Ω 是两个实际电压源，共同向负载 R_L = 4 Ω 供电。用电源等效变换求结点 a 的电压 u_a 和负载电流 i_L，再回到原电路求 i_1、i_2 和 U_s2 吸收的功率。

results.ask: 合并后的电流源（a 对地短路电流）

steps: 1. **变换。** U_s1 串 R_1 → 电流源 16/4 = 4 A（指向 a）并 4 Ω；U_s2 串 R_2 → 电流源 4/2 = 2 A（指向 a）并 2 Ω。箭头都指向电压源“+”端所在的一侧，即结点 a。
5. **U_s2 的功率。** 实际 1 A 从“+”端流入，P = 4 × 1 = **4 W**（吸收）：电动势低的电源被“充电”。验算 KCL：2.5 − 1 = 1.5 ✓。
注意：在变换后的电流源模型里，4 Ω 中的电流是 6/4，与原电路 R_1 中的 2.5 A 不同——等效只对外电路成立。

en.title: Two practical sources in parallel
en.statement: In the circuit, U_s1 = 16 V with R_1 = 4 Ω and U_s2 = 4 V with R_2 = 2 Ω are two practical voltage sources feeding the load R_L = 4 Ω. Use source transformation to find the voltage u_a of node a and the load current i_L, then go back to the original circuit for i_1, i_2 and the power absorbed by U_s2.

results.ask: combined current source (short-circuit current a to ground)

steps: 1. **Transform.** U_s1 with R_1 → current source 16/4 = 4 A (towards a) in parallel with 4 Ω; U_s2 with R_2 → 4/2 = 2 A (towards a) in parallel with 2 Ω. Each arrow points to the side of the “+” terminal, i.e. node a.
2. **Combine.** The two current sources are in the same sense: **6 A**; the three resistors in parallel: G = 1/4 + 1/2 + 1/4 = 1 S, i.e. **1 Ω**.

4. **Back to the original circuit for the internal currents.** i_1 = (16 − 6)/4 = **2.5 A**; i_2 = (4 − 6)/2 = **−1 A** — the minus sign means the actual current flows from a into the “+” terminal of U_s2.
5. **Power of U_s2.** The actual 1 A enters at “+”: P = 4 × 1 = **4 W** (absorbed) — the source with the lower emf is being charged. KCL check: 2.5 − 1 = 1.5 ✓.
Note: in the transformed current-source model the 4 Ω carries 6/4, not the 2.5 A that R_1 carries in the original circuit — the equivalence holds only for the outside.

examples.title: 含 CCVS 的单口网络的输入电阻
examples.statement: 图示单口网络中 R_1 = 6 Ω，R_2 = 3 Ω；电流控制电压源的电压为 3i_1（“+”在上），i_1 为流过 R_1 的电流（向下）。用加压求流法求 a、b 端的输入电阻 R_in。
steps: 1. **外加电压。** 在 a、b 端加电压 u（a 为“+”），端口电流 i 从 a 流入。受控源保留，不能置零。
2. **控制量。** R_1 直接接在端口上：i_1 = u/6。
对比：若错误地把受控源置零（短路），会得到 6 ∥ 3 = 2，比正确结果小——受控源“帮”着抵消了一部分 R_2 中的电流。

en.title: Input resistance of a one-port with a CCVS
en.statement: In the one-port, R_1 = 6 Ω and R_2 = 3 Ω; the current-controlled voltage source has voltage 3i_1 (“+” at the top), where i_1 is the current in R_1 (downwards). Find the input resistance R_in at a, b with the test-voltage method.
steps: 1. **Test voltage.** Apply u across a, b (a positive); the port current i enters at a. Keep the dependent source — it must not be zeroed.
2. **Controlling quantity.** R_1 sits directly across the port: i_1 = u/6.
4. **Port current.** i = i_1 + i_2 = u/3, hence **R_in = u/i = 3 Ω**.
Compare: wrongly zeroing (shorting) the dependent source gives 6 ∥ 3 = 2, too small — the dependent source opposes part of the current in R_2.

mistakes.text: 分流公式写成 i_1 = R_1/(R_1 + R_2)·i。并联时电阻越小分得的电流越大，分子应该是**另一个**电阻。

en.text: Writing the current divider as i_1 = R_1/(R_1 + R_2)·i. In parallel the smaller resistor takes the larger current, so the numerator is the **other** resistor.

mistakes.text: 在等效电路里求被替换部分内部的量（例如变换后模型中内阻的功率、被合并的电流源的功率）。等效只对外电路成立，内部的量要回到原电路求。

en.text: Computing quantities inside the replaced part from the equivalent circuit (e.g. the power in the internal resistance of a transformed source, or of one of several merged current sources). The equivalence holds only outside; go back to the original circuit.

mistakes.text: 电源变换时方向弄反。电流源的箭头一定指向电压源的“+”端；变换前后用“端口短路电流方向相同”检查一下。

en.text: Reversing the direction in a source transformation. The current-source arrow always points to the “+” terminal of the voltage source; check that the short-circuit current at the port has the same direction before and after.

mistakes.text: 求含受控源网络的输入电阻时把受控源置零后直接串并联，或在等效变换中把控制量所在的支路变换掉。受控源要保留，用外加电源法。

en.text: Zeroing a dependent source and then using series–parallel rules to find the input resistance, or transforming away the branch that carries the controlling quantity. Keep the dependent source and use the test-source method.

mistakes.text: 没检查平衡条件就把桥支路去掉。只有 R_1·R_4 = R_2·R_3（对臂乘积相等）时才可以；不平衡时用 Y–Δ 变换。

en.text: Dropping the bridge branch without checking balance. Only allowed when R_1·R_4 = R_2·R_3 (equal products of opposite arms); otherwise use a Y–Δ transformation.

mistakes.text: 按电阻在纸上的位置判断串并联（“画在一排就是串联”）。要按结点判断：导线相连的点是同一结点，先标结点再重画。

en.text: Judging series/parallel by where resistors appear on paper (“drawn in a row means series”). Judge by nodes: points joined by wire are one node — label the nodes, then redraw.
